title: Misleading SECURITY comment claims root cannot be demoted
description:
## Location
rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs lines 405-409

## Issue
Comment says:
```rust
// SECURITY: Role transitions are critical state machine invariants.
// Using unconditional assert! ensures violations are caught in all builds.
let r = self.set_role(DodagRole::Unjoined);
assert!(r.is_ok(), "DODAG version adoption cannot demote a root");
```

But the assertion message is FALSE. Looking at `can_transition_to()` (line 138):
```rust
(Self::Root, Self::Unjoined)  // Returns true!
```

The Root→Unjoined transition IS allowed, so the assert never triggers.

## Why this matters
- Comment implies protection that does not exist
- Developers may rely on this "invariant" that is not enforced
- The actual vulnerability (root dethronement) persists

## Suggested fix
Either:
1. Change state machine to disallow Root→Unjoined (breaking change, may affect `demote()`)
2. Or: Fix the comment to accurately describe behavior and add explicit root check in `adopt_version()`
close_reason: Fixed: Added explicit Root role check in adopt_version() with accurate comment explaining the defense-in-depth relationship with process_dio()
